messages:
pagerduty-bot: [ALERT] P1 - high error rate on /v1/generate in us-east-1. Trigger: 5xx spike + latency > 2s. Pager: @oncall-alex, please acknowledge. https://alerts.redwood.ai/incident/7791234567 :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: acked. Joining war room, dropping link in 30s. Taking owner for now.

sara-eng: FYI hitting 502s from runtime pool-A, saw KV cache misses spike in logs. Dumping sample: `curl -v https://runtime-a-12.local/health` shows 502/timeout.

matt-sre: thanks, sara. tagging `eng-runtime` to check autoscaler and kernel selection. Could be a rollout or kernel miscompile. I'll check node logs.

ops-bot: war room created: https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/7791234567 (owner: oncall-alex). Record: #warroom-7791234567 on Slack.

oncall-alex: joining war room now. Can someone confirm which customers are hitting the errors? Need customer impact ASAP for status page.

leo-support: looked at support queue — 7 distinct customers reporting errors in last 10m, two on dedicated capacity. No major drop in throughput yet but errors are real. List of affected tenant IDs in war room DM.

gabi-pm: preparing a short customer-facing status. Draft below, please confirm: "We are investigating increased errors for text generation in US East. Some requests may see failures or delays. Our engineers are actively diagnosing; we'll update within 30 minutes." OK to post? :eyes:

sara-eng: +1 to draft. Add that we have a mitigation in progress (canary fallback to compatible model) if we trigger it.

oncall-alex: tentative mitigation: route small percent of traffic to model-variant `gptx-compat-1` in us-east to reduce load on failing runtime. Executing canary now: `rctl route set --region us-east --percent 5 --variant gptx-compat-1`

matt-sre: I'm seeing repeated `kv_cache_eviction` warnings on pool-A around the time of spike. Pinning kernels rolled out ~15m ago to a subset; rolling that back on pool-A now: `deployctl rollback --pool pool-A --to revision 143`

ops-bot: rollback initiated by matt-sre. Estimated completion 90s. Monitoring metrics.

oncall-alex: rollback completed. Error rate dropped ~60% in the last 2m. Moving to mitigation verification.

leo-support: support queue warming down, customers acknowledging fewer errors.

gabi-pm: posting status page now. Draft for /status: "We experienced elevated errors for text generation in US East due to a runtime regression after a kernel rollout. We rolled back the affected nodes; service is recovering. Customers may have seen failed requests between 15:02–15:20 UTC. No data exposure. Follow-up will include root cause and timeline." Approve?

sara-eng: approve. Add note: "investigation continues; we will publish RCA within 72 hours."

oncall-alex: posting update to status page and support templates. Status page editor: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/7791234567/edit

ops-bot: status update posted. Support template DM sent to #support with suggested customer wording and next-step checklist.

matt-sre: creating postmortem stub: `docs/incidents/7791234567-postmortem.md` and assigning follow-ups: kernel rollout validation, autoscaler thresholds, KV cache telemetry.

oncall-alex: handing off to matt-sre for deeper investigation. I'm staying on as secondary for 30m. If anything regresses, page me.

leo-support: noting affected customers for dedicated capacity contracts, preparing outreach.

gabi-pm: thanks everyone. Good job on quick rollback and canary. Closing war room in 10m if stable. :white_check_mark:"
